tech.name: FINA 101 · Principles of Finance
tech.description: Prices a bond, a loan and a retirement plan with the time value of money, and shows why risk raises what investors demand.

tech.name: FINA 110 · Corporate Finance
tech.description: Works through capital budgeting, cost of capital, and the financing and payout decisions a firm makes to create value.

tech.name: FINA 120 · Investment Analysis
tech.description: Values stocks and bonds, builds portfolios under the trade-off between risk and return, and tests whether markets price either correctly.

tech.name: FINA 130 · Financial Modeling
tech.description: Builds three-statement, discounted cash flow, and scenario models in spreadsheets, with the sensitivity tests that show where a valuation breaks.

tech.name: FINA 140 · International Finance
tech.description: Covers exchange rates, currency risk and hedging, and how firms raise and move capital across borders.

tech.name: FINA 210 · Real Estate Finance
tech.description: Analyzes mortgages, property valuation, and development pro formas, from a single rental to a securitized pool of loans.

tech.name: FINA 220 · Fintech & Blockchain
tech.description: Examines payments, lending platforms, and distributed ledgers, and asks which of them changes finance and which only re-plumbs it.

tech.name: FINA 230 · Risk Management
tech.description: Measures market, credit, and operational risk with value-at-risk and stress tests, and chooses what to hedge with derivatives and what to insure.

tech.name: FINA 240 · Behavioral Finance
tech.description: Traces how overconfidence, loss aversion, and herding move prices away from what rational models predict, and what that leaves for arbitrage.

tech.name: ACCT 101 · Introduction to Accounting
tech.description: Records a small firm's first year in journal entries and closes it into a balance sheet and an income statement.

tech.name: ACCT 110 · Financial Accounting
tech.description: Prepares and reads the balance sheet, income statement, and cash-flow statement under the standards that govern external reporting.

tech.name: ACCT 120 · Managerial Accounting
tech.description: Turns cost data into decisions — budgeting, break-even analysis, variance reports, and pricing — for the people who run the business.

tech.name: ACCT 130 · Tax Fundamentals
tech.description: Covers how income, deductions, and credits are computed for individuals and businesses, and how tax planning changes a decision.

tech.name: ACCT 140 · Auditing Principles
tech.description: Teaches how an auditor gathers evidence, tests internal controls, and decides whether a company's financial statements can be relied on.

tech.name: ACCT 210 · Forensic Accounting
tech.description: Follows money through fraud schemes, asset tracing, and litigation support, using the accounting record as evidence.

tech.name: ACCT 220 · Intermediate Financial Reporting
tech.description: Handles the hard cases in external reporting — revenue recognition, leases, pensions, income taxes — and ends with consolidations.

tech.name: ACCT 230 · Cost Accounting
tech.description: Designs costing systems for complex operations, from activity-based costing to transfer prices and the performance measures they distort.

tech.name: ACCT 240 · Accounting Information Systems
tech.description: Examines how transactions flow through enterprise software, the controls built into that flow, and where it fails.

tech.name: MRKT 101 · Fundamentals of Marketing
tech.description: Surveys the marketing mix — product, price, place, and promotion — through real brand cases.

tech.name: MRKT 110 · Consumer Behavior
tech.description: Draws on psychology and economics to explain how people notice, evaluate, and choose products, and how often habit and context make the choice instead.

tech.name: MRKT 120 · Market Research
tech.description: Designs surveys, focus groups, and experiments, and turns their data into estimates a marketing decision can rest on.

tech.name: MRKT 130 · Digital Marketing Strategy
tech.description: Plans search, social, email, and paid campaigns around the funnel, and measures them with attribution rather than impressions.

tech.name: MRKT 140 · Brand Management
tech.description: Builds and defends a brand as an asset: positioning, identity, extensions, and the valuation of what the name alone is worth.

tech.name: MRKT 210 · Sports Marketing
tech.description: Applies sponsorship, ticketing, media rights, and fan engagement to teams, leagues, and the athletes who front them.

tech.name: MRKT 220 · Advertising & Promotion
tech.description: Develops creative briefs, media plans, and promotional offers, and evaluates a campaign against the behavior it set out to change.

tech.name: MRKT 230 · Sales Management
tech.description: Organizes a sales force — territories, quotas, compensation, pipeline forecasting — and the coaching that lifts a team's close rate.

tech.name: MRKT 240 · Global Marketing
tech.description: Adapts product, price, and message across cultures, currencies, and regulators, and decides when to standardize and when to localize.

tech.name: Experimental Economics Lab
tech.description: Behavioral labs and market-simulation suites — required for the Economics program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: ECON 101 · Microeconomics
tech.description: Examines how individuals and firms make decisions under scarcity, from supply and demand to market structure.

tech.name: ECON 110 · Macroeconomics
tech.description: Models output, unemployment, inflation, and growth for a whole economy, and what monetary and fiscal policy can do about them.

tech.name: ECON 120 · Econometrics
tech.description: Fits regression lines to economic data and tests whether a correlation, however strong, can be read as a cause.

tech.name: ECON 130 · Intermediate Microeconomics
tech.description: Reworks consumer choice, the firm, and market failure with the calculus the principles course left out, and derives what that course could only assert.

tech.name: ECON 140 · Economic History
tech.description: Reads the Industrial Revolution, the Great Depression, and the postwar boom as tests of economic theory rather than as a chronicle.

tech.name: ECON 210 · Behavioral Economics
tech.description: Replaces the rational agent with the one experiments find, and works out what bounded rationality and present bias do to markets and policy.

tech.name: ECON 220 · Public Finance
tech.description: Analyzes taxation, public spending, and debt: who bears a tax, what a public good is worth, and when redistribution costs efficiency.

tech.name: ECON 230 · Game Theory
tech.description: Solves strategic interaction with Nash equilibrium, backward induction, and signaling, from auctions to arms races.

tech.name: ECON 240 · Environmental Economics
tech.description: Prices pollution, climate damage, and natural resources, and compares taxes, tradable permits, and regulation by what each costs per ton of emissions cut.

tech.name: MGMT 101 · Organizational Leadership
tech.description: Studies how teams form, stall and recover, and what a first-time manager can do about each, through cases and team projects.

tech.name: MGMT 110 · Human Resources Management
tech.description: Covers recruiting, compensation, performance review, and employment law, and how each shapes who stays and how they work.

tech.name: MGMT 120 · Operations Management
tech.description: Designs the processes that make and deliver things: capacity, scheduling, quality, and the bottlenecks that set throughput.

tech.name: MGMT 130 · Business Ethics
tech.description: Tests corporate decisions against moral frameworks, stakeholder claims, and the cases where the law permitted what the public would not.

tech.name: MGMT 140 · Strategic Management
tech.description: Analyzes industries with the five forces and a firm with its resources and capabilities, and asks which advantages survive once rivals respond.

tech.name: MGMT 210 · Project Management
tech.description: Plans scope, schedule, budget, and risk with work breakdowns and critical paths, and steers a project as those plans meet reality.

tech.name: MGMT 220 · Entrepreneurship
tech.description: Takes an idea through customer discovery, business models, and fundraising to a launch, with the failure modes of each stage.

tech.name: MGMT 230 · Conflict Resolution
tech.description: Diagnoses workplace disputes and applies mediation, interest-based bargaining, and structured processes to settle them.

tech.name: MGMT 240 · Negotiations
tech.description: Prepares, conducts, and reviews negotiations through live simulations, from distributive haggling to multi-party deals with hidden interests.

tech.name: SPCO 101 · Introduction to Supply Chain
tech.description: Traces how goods move from raw material to customer, and where supply chains break down.

tech.name: SPCO 110 · Logistics & Distribution
tech.description: Plans warehousing, transportation modes, and delivery networks, and trades off inventory against speed and cost.

tech.name: SPCO 120 · Procurement & Sourcing
tech.description: Selects and manages suppliers, negotiates contracts, and weighs total cost of ownership against price, risk, and ethics.

tech.name: SPCO 130 · Quality Management
tech.description: Applies statistical process control, Six Sigma, and root-cause analysis to keep defects out of a product before inspection finds them.

tech.name: SPCO 140 · Demand Planning
tech.description: Forecasts what customers will order from history, promotions, and market signals, and reconciles the forecast with what operations can supply.

tech.name: SPCO 210 · Global Supply Chains
tech.description: Manages sourcing and distribution across borders: tariffs, currency, lead times, and the resilience a shock like a port closure demands.

tech.name: SPCO 220 · Inventory Control Systems
tech.description: Sets reorder points, safety stock, and replenishment policies, and tunes them for demand that is uncertain and lead times that slip.

tech.name: SPCO 230 · Data Analytics for Operations
tech.description: Applies optimization, simulation, and forecasting models to routing, scheduling, and stock decisions, using real operational data.

tech.name: SPCO 240 · Transportation Management
tech.description: Plans carrier selection, fleet routing, and freight contracts across road, rail, sea, and air, under regulation and fuel cost.

tech.name: Mechanical Engineering Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Mechanical Engineering program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: MECH 101 · Introduction to Mechanical Design
tech.description: Teaches freehand sketching, CAD, and engineering drawing, and has each team build a prototype that must meet a written specification.

tech.name: MECH 110 · Statics & Dynamics
tech.description: Analyzes forces and moments on trusses, frames, and machines at rest, then on particles and rigid bodies under acceleration.

tech.name: MECH 120 · Thermodynamics
tech.description: Applies the first and second laws to engines, refrigerators, and power cycles, with property tables and the entropy budget of each.

tech.name: MECH 130 · Fluid Mechanics
tech.description: Covers pressure, viscosity, and flow in pipes and around bodies, from Bernoulli and the Navier-Stokes equations to boundary layers and drag.

tech.name: MECH 140 · Materials Science
tech.description: Relates the structure of metals, polymers, ceramics, and composites to their strength, failure, and processing.

tech.name: MECH 210 · Robotics
tech.description: Designs manipulators and mobile robots: kinematics, actuators, sensors, and the control loops that make them move where intended.

tech.name: MECH 220 · HVAC Systems
tech.description: Sizes heating, cooling, and ventilation equipment from load calculations and psychrometric charts, and checks the building against the energy code.

tech.name: MECH 230 · Internal Combustion Engines
tech.description: Analyzes spark- and compression-ignition cycles, combustion, and emissions, and tunes a running engine on a dynamometer.

tech.name: MECH 240 · Finite Element Analysis
tech.description: Formulates and solves stress, thermal, and vibration problems numerically, and learns when a converged result is still wrong.

tech.name: Electrical Engineering Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Electrical Engineering program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: ELEC 101 · Circuits
tech.description: Solves resistive, RC, and RL circuits with Kirchhoff's laws, nodal analysis, and Thévenin equivalents, and checks each answer on a breadboard.

tech.name: ELEC 110 · Digital Logic Design
tech.description: Designs combinational and sequential circuits from gates and flip-flops, and builds them on programmable hardware.

tech.name: ELEC 120 · Signals & Systems
tech.description: Analyzes continuous and discrete signals with Fourier, Laplace, and z-transforms, and the linear systems that filter them.

tech.name: ELEC 130 · Electromagnetics
tech.description: Develops Maxwell's equations for static and time-varying fields, transmission lines, and waves, with the antennas and waveguides they explain.

tech.name: ELEC 140 · Microelectronics
tech.description: Analyzes and designs diode and transistor circuits with small-signal models, and biases amplifiers to tolerate temperature drift and part-to-part variation.

tech.name: ELEC 210 · Power Systems Analysis
tech.description: Models generation, transmission, and load flow in the electrical grid, with fault analysis and the stability of the network.

tech.name: ELEC 220 · Wireless Communications
tech.description: Covers modulation, coding, fading channels, and multiple access, and works out the link budget that decides whether a call connects.

tech.name: ELEC 230 · Control Systems
tech.description: Designs feedback controllers with root locus, frequency response, and state space, and tunes them for stability and performance on real plants.

tech.name: ELEC 240 · VLSI Design
tech.description: Lays out digital circuits in CMOS from transistor to chip, with timing, power, and the design flow that gets a chip fabricated.

tech.name: Chemical Engineering Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Chemical Engineering program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: CHEN 101 · Principles of Chemical Engineering
tech.description: Follows a barrel of crude and a vat of corn mash through a plant, and names the unit operation each step takes.

tech.name: CHEN 110 · Chemical Thermodynamics
tech.description: Starts with energy balances on flowing streams, then applies phase and chemical equilibrium to the separations and reactions a plant depends on.

tech.name: CHEN 120 · Fluid Transport
tech.description: Calculates friction losses, pump heads, and pressure drops for process piping, with the Reynolds number deciding which correlation applies.

tech.name: CHEN 130 · Material & Energy Balances
tech.description: Closes mass and energy balances on a whole flowsheet, with recycle, purge, and reaction, the bookkeeping a plant design is checked against.

tech.name: CHEN 140 · Chemical Reaction Engineering
tech.description: Sizes batch, stirred, and tubular reactors from kinetics and residence time, with heat effects and catalysis.

tech.name: CHEN 210 · Process Safety
tech.description: Analyzes hazards, relief systems, and layers of protection with HAZOP studies and the case histories of plant disasters, so a design fails safely.

tech.name: CHEN 220 · Biochemical Engineering
tech.description: Engineers fermentation, enzyme reactors, and downstream purification to make pharmaceuticals and fuels from living cells.

tech.name: CHEN 230 · Polymer Science
tech.description: Covers polymerization, molecular weight, and the viscoelastic behavior of plastics, with the processing that shapes them.

tech.name: CHEN 240 · Sustainable Energy Technology
tech.description: Evaluates biofuels, hydrogen, carbon capture, and electrochemical storage on efficiency, cost, and life-cycle emissions.

tech.name: Civil Engineering Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Civil Engineering program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: CIVE 101 · Statics
tech.description: Covers forces in equilibrium, free-body diagrams, and load paths, the physical foundation for structural and civil design.

tech.name: CIVE 110 · Structural Analysis
tech.description: Finds member forces in determinate trusses, frames, and beams by statics alone, and tracks moving loads through them with influence lines.

tech.name: CIVE 120 · Soil Mechanics
tech.description: Covers soil classification, seepage, consolidation, and shear strength — the ground properties a foundation design rests on.

tech.name: CIVE 130 · Mechanics of Materials
tech.description: Relates loads to stress, strain, and deflection in bars, shafts, and beams, up to buckling and combined loading.

tech.name: CIVE 140 · Transportation Engineering
tech.description: Designs roads, intersections, and transit systems from traffic flow, capacity analysis, and geometric standards.

tech.name: CIVE 210 · Bridge Design
tech.description: Designs a bridge from concept through loads, girders, bearings, and substructure to the code checks a real span must pass.

tech.name: CIVE 220 · Environmental Impact Assessment
tech.description: Assesses the effects of a proposed project on air, water, land, and communities, and writes the statement regulators require.

tech.name: CIVE 230 · Construction Management
tech.description: Plans a construction project — estimating, scheduling, contracts, procurement, and safety — on a site with weather and subcontractors.

tech.name: CIVE 240 · Urban Planning
tech.description: Covers zoning, land use, transportation, and housing, and drafts a comprehensive plan that has to survive a public hearing.

tech.name: INDE 101 · Introduction to Industrial Systems
tech.description: Maps a process, times its jobs with a stopwatch, and puts a dollar figure on each proposed improvement.

tech.name: INDE 110 · Production Planning
tech.description: Schedules materials, machines, and people to meet demand, with MRP, capacity planning, and the trade-off between inventory and lead time.

tech.name: INDE 120 · Ergonomics & Safety
tech.description: Designs workstations, tools, and tasks around the human body, with the hazard analysis that keeps a workplace from injuring it.

tech.name: INDE 130 · Quality Control
tech.description: Applies control charts, sampling plans, and process capability to detect drift before it becomes defects.

tech.name: INDE 140 · Facilities Design
tech.description: Lays out plants and warehouses for material flow, with location analysis and the space each operation needs.

tech.name: INDE 210 · Simulation Modeling
tech.description: Builds discrete-event models of factories, hospitals, and queues, and runs experiments on them that would be too costly in real life.

tech.name: INDE 220 · Supply Chain Analytics
tech.description: Optimizes network design, inventory, and sourcing with mathematical programming and data from a real supply chain.

tech.name: INDE 230 · Lean Manufacturing
tech.description: Applies value-stream mapping, pull systems, and continuous improvement to take the waste out of a production line.

tech.name: INDE 240 · Reliability Engineering
tech.description: Models failure with life distributions and fault trees, and designs maintenance and redundancy for systems that must not stop.

tech.name: Aerospace Engineering Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Aerospace Engineering program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: AERO 101 · Introduction to Aerospace Engineering
tech.description: Surveys the standard atmosphere, airfoils, aircraft performance, and orbits, with a first look at stability and propulsion.

tech.name: AERO 110 · Aerodynamics
tech.description: Predicts lift and drag on airfoils and wings with potential-flow theory and compressibility corrections, and tests the predictions in a wind tunnel.

tech.name: AERO 120 · Aircraft Performance
tech.description: Computes range, endurance, climb, and takeoff and landing distances from an aircraft's thrust, drag, and weight.

tech.name: AERO 130 · Spacecraft Propulsion
tech.description: Covers chemical rockets, electric thrusters, and the rocket equation, with nozzle design and propellant choice.

tech.name: AERO 140 · Aerospace Structures
tech.description: Analyzes thin-walled beams, stressed skins, and composites under flight loads, with fatigue and the margins certification demands.

tech.name: AERO 210 · Astrodynamics
tech.description: Solves two-body orbits, transfers, and rendezvous, and plans interplanetary trajectories with gravity assists.

tech.name: AERO 220 · Rocketry
tech.description: Designs, builds, and flies a sounding rocket as a team, and answers for its motor choice, stability margin, and recovery.

tech.name: AERO 230 · Aircraft Design
tech.description: Takes an aircraft from mission requirements through sizing, configuration, and trade studies to a preliminary design review.

tech.name: AERO 240 · Unmanned Aerial Systems
tech.description: Builds and operates drones — airframes, autopilots, and sensors — under the FAA rules on where and how high they may fly.

tech.name: MDIA 101 · Mass Communication
tech.description: Measures what newspapers, broadcasters and platforms each reach, and what the research says they do to opinion.

tech.name: MDIA 110 · Media Theory
tech.description: Reads the major theories of media effects and meaning, from propaganda models to audience reception, against what the evidence supports.

tech.name: MDIA 120 · Global Media Systems
tech.description: Compares how press freedom, ownership, and public broadcasting differ across countries, and what each arrangement does to the news.

tech.name: MDIA 130 · Digital Culture
tech.description: Examines how platforms, algorithms, and participatory media reshape identity, community, and the public sphere.

tech.name: MDIA 140 · Media Ethics
tech.description: Works through privacy, deception, harm, and conflict of interest in journalism and entertainment, case by case.

tech.name: MDIA 210 · Film Industry
tech.description: Follows a film from development finance through distribution windows and marketing, and how streaming rewrote the economics.

tech.name: MDIA 220 · Social Media Analytics
tech.description: Measures reach, sentiment, and network spread across platforms, and separates a real audience signal from bots and vanity metrics.

tech.name: MDIA 230 · Photojournalism
tech.description: Shoots, edits, and captions news photographs under deadline, with the ethics of staging, cropping, and consent.

tech.name: MDIA 240 · Public Relations
tech.description: Manages an organization's reputation through media relations, crisis response, and campaigns, and measures what the coverage did.

tech.name: GRDS 101 · Visual Communication
tech.description: Composes shape, color, and type on posters and signs, and tests what a viewer sees first against what the designer meant.

tech.name: GRDS 110 · Typography
tech.description: Sets type with attention to letterform, hierarchy, spacing, and grid, from a single word mark to a running text page.

tech.name: GRDS 120 · Digital Imaging
tech.description: Edits and composes raster and vector images for print and screen, with color management and resolution handled correctly.

tech.name: GRDS 130 · Layout Design
tech.description: Arranges type and image on the page and the screen using grids, hierarchy, and white space, for editorial and advertising work.

tech.name: GRDS 140 · Branding & Identity
tech.description: Develops logos, identity systems, and brand guidelines, and tests them across the applications a client will actually use.

tech.name: GRDS 210 · Web Design
tech.description: Designs responsive interfaces in HTML and CSS with attention to navigation, accessibility, and performance on real devices.

tech.name: GRDS 220 · Motion Graphics
tech.description: Animates type and graphics for title sequences, explainers, and broadcast, using timing and easing to carry meaning.

tech.name: GRDS 230 · Illustration
tech.description: Develops a personal visual language through editorial, book, and concept illustration in traditional and digital media.

tech.name: GRDS 240 · Publication Design
tech.description: Designs a complete magazine or book, from pacing and typographic system through the cover to press-ready files.

tech.name: CRWR 101 · Introduction to Creative Writing
tech.description: Writes a poem and a short story a week, read aloud and critiqued, to learn what revision is for.

tech.name: CRWR 110 · Fiction Workshop
tech.description: Drafts and revises short stories under group critique, with close attention to point of view, scene, and structure.

tech.name: CRWR 120 · Poetry Workshop
tech.description: Writes in received and open forms, revising for image, line, and sound under weekly critique.

tech.name: CRWR 130 · Nonfiction Workshop
tech.description: Writes memoir, essay, and reportage, and works out the obligations to fact and to other people that fiction does not carry.

tech.name: CRWR 140 · Literary Editing
tech.description: Edits other writers' manuscripts at the line and the structural level, and produces a small literary magazine from submission to print.

tech.name: CRWR 210 · Screenwriting
tech.description: Writes a feature-length screenplay in industry format, from logline and outline through three-act structure and dialogue.

tech.name: CRWR 220 · Playwriting
tech.description: Develops a one-act play in which everything must be said or done onstage, and hears each draft read aloud by actors.

tech.name: CRWR 230 · Novel Writing
tech.description: Plans and drafts the opening of a novel, sustaining character and plot across a length the short story never asks for.

tech.name: CRWR 240 · Creative Writing Seminar
tech.description: Completes a polished manuscript in the writer's chosen genre, alongside the craft reading and the query letter to send with it.

tech.name: MUSC 101 · Music Theory I
tech.description: Covers notation, scales, and harmony, the building blocks of Western music.

tech.name: MUSC 110 · Music Theory II
tech.description: Extends harmony into chromaticism, modulation, and form, analyzing sonatas and songs from the score.

tech.name: MUSC 120 · Music History Survey
tech.description: Traces Western art music from chant and Renaissance polyphony through Bach, Beethoven, and Stravinsky, by listening and score study.

tech.name: MUSC 130 · Composition I
tech.description: Writes short pieces for solo instruments and small ensembles, and hears them performed and critiqued.

tech.name: MUSC 140 · Applied Instrument/Voice
tech.description: Gives weekly private lessons on the student's instrument or voice, building technique and repertoire toward a juried performance.

tech.name: MUSC 210 · Jazz Improvisation
tech.description: Improvises over standards and blues forms, learning chord-scale relationships, voicings, and the vocabulary of the tradition by ear.

tech.name: MUSC 220 · World Music
tech.description: Studies musical traditions from West Africa, India, Indonesia, and the Andes through performance as well as listening.

tech.name: MUSC 230 · Music Technology
tech.description: Records, mixes, and produces music in a digital audio workstation, with synthesis, sampling, and live electronics.

tech.name: MUSC 240 · Composition II
tech.description: Composes an extended work for larger forces, orchestrated and rehearsed toward a public premiere.

tech.name: Media Production Studio
tech.description: Sound stages, edit bays and a screening theater — required for the Film program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: FILM 101 · Introduction to Film Analysis
tech.description: Teaches close reading of cinema through shot composition, editing, and narrative structure.

tech.name: FILM 110 · Cinematography
tech.description: Teaches lighting, lenses, exposure, and camera movement on set, and how each choice shapes what an audience feels.

tech.name: FILM 120 · Screenwriting Workshop
tech.description: Develops short scripts through outline, draft, and table read, with structure and dialogue revised under critique.

tech.name: FILM 130 · Film Production
tech.description: Takes a short film from pre-production through the shoot as a crew, rotating through the roles a set depends on.

tech.name: FILM 140 · Directing Fundamentals
tech.description: Works with actors, blocks scenes, and translates a script into shot lists, with the director's decisions tested on set.

tech.name: FILM 210 · Documentary Filmmaking
tech.description: Researches, shoots, and edits a nonfiction film, negotiating access, consent, and the line between observing and staging.

tech.name: FILM 220 · History of World Cinema
tech.description: Surveys national cinemas since the silent era by their movements: Soviet montage, Italian neorealism, the French New Wave, and Brazil's Cinema Novo.

tech.name: FILM 230 · Sound Design
tech.description: Records dialogue, builds effects and ambience, and mixes them into a soundtrack that does half the storytelling.

tech.name: FILM 240 · Post-Production
tech.description: Edits, color-grades, and finishes a film to delivery, with the workflow and versioning a real release requires.

tech.name: SART 101 · Fundamentals of 2D Design
tech.description: Works through line, shape, balance and figure-ground in cut paper and ink, critiqued on the wall each week.

tech.name: SART 110 · Drawing
tech.description: Builds observational skill in line, value, and proportion from still life and the figure, in charcoal, graphite, and ink.

tech.name: SART 120 · Painting
tech.description: Works in oil and acrylic on color mixing, surface, and composition, from studies to sustained canvases.

tech.name: SART 130 · Sculpture
tech.description: Builds in clay, plaster, wood, and found material, and learns what changes when a work occupies space rather than a wall.

tech.name: SART 140 · Art History Survey
tech.description: Covers painting, sculpture, and architecture period by period, with slide identifications and the formal analysis a studio critique borrows.

tech.name: SART 210 · Printmaking
tech.description: Covers relief, intaglio, and screen printing, from plate and stencil to the edition.

tech.name: SART 220 · Ceramics
tech.description: Throws and hand-builds vessels and sculptural forms, and fires and glazes them with an understanding of the chemistry involved.

tech.name: SART 230 · Photography
tech.description: Shoots, develops, and prints in the darkroom and the digital lab, with the history of the medium alongside the technique.

tech.name: SART 240 · Digital Art
tech.description: Makes work in generative code, 3D modeling, video, and interactive media, exhibited on screens rather than paper.

tech.name: ENGL 101 · Introduction to Literary Studies
tech.description: Reads a sonnet, a short story and a play line by line, and builds an argument about each from the words on the page.

tech.name: ENGL 110 · British Literature Survey
tech.description: Reads Beowulf, Chaucer, Milton, the Romantics, and Woolf in order, and how English itself changed as a literary language.

tech.name: ENGL 120 · American Literature Survey
tech.description: Asks what makes a literature American rather than English, through Bradstreet, Douglass, Dickinson, Twain, Faulkner, and Morrison.

tech.name: ENGL 130 · Critical Theory
tech.description: Introduces the schools of criticism — formalist, Marxist, psychoanalytic, feminist, postcolonial — and puts each to work on a text.

tech.name: ENGL 140 · Rhetoric & Composition
tech.description: Builds argumentative and research writing for an academic audience, with sustained revision and attention to style.

tech.name: ENGL 210 · Shakespeare
tech.description: Reads a dozen plays across comedy, history, and tragedy, with attention to staging, language, and the texts' unsettled histories.

tech.name: ENGL 220 · Restoration & 18th Century Literature
tech.description: Reads Dryden, Swift, Pope, and the rise of the novel in a century of coffeehouses, satire, and print.

tech.name: ENGL 230 · Postcolonial Literature
tech.description: Reads writing from Africa, South Asia, and the Caribbean in the wake of empire, and the theory that grew up around it.

tech.name: ENGL 240 · Technical Writing
tech.description: Writes documentation, proposals, and reports for expert and lay readers, with structure, plain language, and usability testing.

tech.name: SOCY 101 · Introduction to Sociology
tech.description: Shows how class, family, school and work shape choices people believe are their own, with the surveys that measure it.

tech.name: SOCY 110 · Social Stratification
tech.description: Analyzes class, status, and power: how inequality is measured, reproduced across generations, and justified.

tech.name: SOCY 120 · Sociological Theory
tech.description: Reads Marx, Weber, Durkheim, and their successors, and asks what each framework explains that the others cannot.

tech.name: SOCY 130 · Race & Ethnicity
tech.description: Examines how racial and ethnic categories are made, enforced, and contested, and their effects on housing, schooling, and justice.

tech.name: SOCY 140 · Qualitative Research Methods
tech.description: Trains interviewing, ethnographic observation, and the coding of field notes, with the ethics of studying people up close.

tech.name: SOCY 210 · Criminology
tech.description: Explains crime and punishment through theories of strain, control, and labeling, and tests them against crime statistics and the courts.

tech.name: SOCY 220 · Sociology of the Family
tech.description: Studies how marriage, parenting, and kinship vary across class and culture and have changed over a century.

tech.name: SOCY 230 · Urban Sociology
tech.description: Examines segregation, gentrification, and neighborhood effects, and how cities shape the lives lived in them.

tech.name: SOCY 240 · Sex & Gender
tech.description: Analyzes how gender is socially constructed and enforced, in work, family, and the body, and how sexuality intersects with it.

tech.name: ANTH 101 · Introduction to Anthropology
tech.description: Introduces cultural, biological, linguistic and archaeological anthropology, each through the one case it explains best.

tech.name: ANTH 110 · Cultural Anthropology
tech.description: Studies kinship, ritual, exchange, and belief across societies through ethnography, and what fieldwork can and cannot see.

tech.name: ANTH 120 · Biological Anthropology
tech.description: Covers human evolution, primate behavior, and modern human variation, from fossil evidence to genetics.

tech.name: ANTH 130 · Archaeological Methods
tech.description: Teaches survey, excavation, stratigraphy, and dating, and how material remains are turned into claims about the past.

tech.name: ANTH 140 · Linguistic Anthropology
tech.description: Examines how language shapes and reflects culture: dialect, politeness, multilingualism, and language loss.

tech.name: ANTH 210 · Ethnographic Field Methods
tech.description: Designs and carries out a small ethnographic project, from gaining access to writing up, with the ethics at every step.

tech.name: ANTH 220 · Medical Anthropology
tech.description: Compares how cultures understand illness, healing, and the body, and what that means for medicine delivered across them.

tech.name: ANTH 230 · Anthropology of Religion
tech.description: Studies myth, ritual, magic, and belief, and whether to explain them, as Durkheim did, or interpret them, as Geertz did.

tech.name: ANTH 240 · Museum & Heritage Studies
tech.description: Examines collecting, display, repatriation, and heritage policy, and who gets to tell whose past.

tech.name: POLS 101 · Introduction to Political Science
tech.description: Asks who gets what, when, and how, and introduces the states, parties, and elections that decide it.

tech.name: POLS 110 · Comparative Politics
tech.description: Compares regimes, party systems, and institutions across countries to explain why democracies and dictatorships rise, endure, and fall.

tech.name: POLS 120 · International Relations
tech.description: Introduces realism, liberalism, and constructivism, and applies them to war, trade, alliances, and international organizations.

tech.name: POLS 130 · American Government
tech.description: Examines the Constitution, the separation of powers, federalism, and the parties and interest groups that work them.

tech.name: POLS 140 · Public Policy Analysis
tech.description: Defines a policy problem, weighs alternatives with cost-benefit analysis and evidence, and explains why the best option often loses.

tech.name: POLS 210 · Constitutional Law
tech.description: Reads the landmark cases on judicial review, federal power, and civil liberties, and how doctrine changes with the Court.

tech.name: POLS 220 · Political Campaigns
tech.description: Studies how campaigns are strategized, funded, and run, from polling and messaging to turnout, using a live election where there is one.

tech.name: POLS 230 · Theories of Justice
tech.description: Reads Rawls, Nozick, and their critics on what a just distribution and a legitimate state would be.

tech.name: POLS 240 · Security Studies
tech.description: Analyzes war, deterrence, terrorism, and cyber conflict, and the intelligence and defense institutions built to meet them.

tech.name: Humanities Research Institute
tech.description: Archives, reading rooms and a documents collection — required for the History program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: HIST 101 · World History
tech.description: Compares farming, empire, and trade across Afro-Eurasia and the Americas, and how contact bound them into one world.

tech.name: HIST 110 · Research & Historiography
tech.description: Builds an argument from primary sources, and reads how Marxist, Annales, and cultural historians have told the same past differently.

tech.name: HIST 120 · US History
tech.description: Follows the Revolution, the Civil War and Reconstruction, the New Deal, and civil rights as one long argument over who counts as a citizen.

tech.name: HIST 130 · European History
tech.description: Asks how the Reformation, the French Revolution, and nationalism built Europe's nation-states, and how their rivalries led to 1914 and 1939.

tech.name: HIST 140 · Ancient Civilizations
tech.description: Studies Mesopotamia, Egypt, Greece, and Rome through their texts and material remains, and what each left behind.

tech.name: HIST 210 · World War I & II
tech.description: Examines the causes, conduct, and consequences of the two world wars, from the trenches and the home front to the peace settlements.

tech.name: HIST 220 · Historical Archaeology
tech.description: Uses excavated material alongside written records to recover the lives of people the documents left out.

tech.name: HIST 230 · Historical Anthropology
tech.description: Reads village feuds, witch trials, and carnival as an anthropologist would, working from court and parish records instead of fieldwork.

tech.name: HIST 240 · History of Science & Technology
tech.description: Traces how scientific ideas and machines were made, contested, and adopted, from the Scientific Revolution to the digital age.

tech.name: PHIL 101 · Introduction to Logic & Reasoning
tech.description: Puts arguments into standard form, tests their validity, and names the fallacies that make bad ones persuasive.

tech.name: PHIL 110 · Ethics
tech.description: Examines utilitarian, deontological, and virtue theories of right action, and tests them on real moral problems.

tech.name: PHIL 120 · Metaphysics
tech.description: Asks what exists — numbers, universals, possible worlds — and what makes something the same thing over time or an action free.

tech.name: PHIL 130 · Epistemology
tech.description: Studies knowledge, justification, and skepticism, and what testimony, perception, and reason can each be trusted to deliver.

tech.name: PHIL 140 · Ancient Greek Philosophy
tech.description: Reads the Presocratics, Plato, and Aristotle closely, on nature, knowledge, the soul, and the good life.

tech.name: PHIL 210 · Existentialism
tech.description: Reads Kierkegaard, Nietzsche, Heidegger, Sartre, and de Beauvoir on freedom, anxiety, authenticity, and meaning without guarantee.

tech.name: PHIL 220 · Philosophy of Mind
tech.description: Examines consciousness, intentionality, and the mind-body problem, and whether a machine could be conscious or think about anything.

tech.name: PHIL 230 · Aesthetics
tech.description: Asks what art is, what makes a judgment of beauty more than a preference, and how a work can mean anything.

tech.name: PHIL 240 · Symbolic Logic
tech.description: Develops propositional and first-order logic with proofs and models, up to the completeness and the limits of the systems.

tech.name: MATH 101 · Calculus
tech.description: Applies limits, derivatives, and integrals to related rates, optimization, and area, and proves the fundamental theorem that joins them.

tech.name: MATH 110 · Linear Algebra
tech.description: Covers vector spaces, matrices, eigenvalues, and linear maps, with the geometry and the applications that make them indispensable.

tech.name: MATH 120 · Probability & Statistics
tech.description: Develops random variables, distributions, and the central limit theorem, and applies them to estimation and hypothesis testing.

tech.name: MATH 130 · Discrete Mathematics
tech.description: Covers logic, sets, combinatorics, graphs, and proof by induction — the mathematics beneath computing.

tech.name: MATH 140 · Differential Equations
tech.description: Solves ordinary differential equations analytically and numerically, and models the oscillators, populations, and circuits they describe.

tech.name: MATH 210 · Real Analysis
tech.description: Builds the real numbers, limits, continuity, and the integral rigorously, and proves the theorems calculus took on trust.

tech.name: MATH 220 · Abstract Algebra
tech.description: Studies groups, rings, and fields through symmetry and permutations, and shows why no formula in radicals solves every quintic.

tech.name: MATH 230 · Topology
tech.description: Defines open sets, continuity, compactness, and connectedness in the abstract, and uses the fundamental group to tell a sphere from a torus.

tech.name: MATH 240 · Numerical Methods
tech.description: Analyzes algorithms for root finding, integration, linear systems, and differential equations, with the error and stability of each.

tech.name: Biology Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Biology program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: BIOL 101 · Principles of Biology
tech.description: Surveys cells, genes, evolution, and ecosystems, with a weekly lab of microscopes, pipettes, and fruit flies.

tech.name: BIOL 110 · Cell Biology
tech.description: Examines membranes, organelles, signaling, and the cell cycle, and the experimental methods that revealed them.

tech.name: BIOL 120 · Genetics
tech.description: Covers inheritance from Mendel to the genome: linkage, mutation, gene regulation, and the tools of molecular genetics.

tech.name: BIOL 130 · Ecology
tech.description: Studies populations, communities, and ecosystems, with field work on how organisms interact with each other and their environment.

tech.name: BIOL 140 · Evolution
tech.description: Explains natural selection, genetic drift, speciation, and phylogenetics, and tests them against the fossil record and DNA sequences.

tech.name: BIOL 210 · Microbiology
tech.description: Grows, stains, and identifies bacteria in the lab, and covers archaea, viruses, fungi, pathogenesis, and how antibiotics work and fail.

tech.name: BIOL 220 · Marine Biology
tech.description: Examines plankton, invertebrates, fish, and marine mammals, with coastal sampling in estuaries, salt marshes, and tide pools.

tech.name: BIOL 230 · Plant Physiology
tech.description: Covers photosynthesis, water transport, hormones, and development, and how plants respond to stress and season.

tech.name: BIOL 240 · Immunology
tech.description: Traces innate and adaptive immunity through antigen recognition, antibodies, and T cells, and applies it to vaccines, allergy, and autoimmune disease.

tech.name: Chemistry Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Chemistry program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: CHEM 101 · General Chemistry
tech.description: Balances equations, counts moles, and works through atomic structure, bonding, gases, and equilibrium, in a lab where yields rarely match the arithmetic.

tech.name: CHEM 110 · Inorganic Chemistry
tech.description: Covers bonding, coordination complexes, and the descriptive chemistry of the main-group and transition elements.

tech.name: CHEM 120 · Organic Chemistry
tech.description: Develops the structure, stereochemistry, and reaction mechanisms of carbon compounds, with synthesis and spectroscopy in the lab.

tech.name: CHEM 130 · Analytical Chemistry
tech.description: Teaches titration, chromatography, and electrochemical and spectroscopic analysis, with the statistics that say how far to trust a measurement.

tech.name: CHEM 140 · Physical Chemistry
tech.description: Develops thermodynamics, kinetics, and quantum mechanics as they apply to molecules, with the mathematics each requires.

tech.name: CHEM 210 · Biochemistry
tech.description: Examines proteins, enzymes, nucleic acids, and metabolism, and how the chemistry of the cell is regulated.

tech.name: CHEM 220 · Spectroscopy & Structure Determination
tech.description: Solves molecular structures from NMR, infrared, and mass spectra, and from X-ray diffraction when a crystal can be grown.

tech.name: CHEM 230 · Medicinal Chemistry
tech.description: Follows a drug from target and lead compound through structure-activity relationships to metabolism and dose.

tech.name: CHEM 240 · Computational Chemistry
tech.description: Models molecules with quantum chemistry and molecular dynamics, and learns what each method can and cannot predict.

tech.name: Physics Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Physics program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: PHYS 101 · Classical Mechanics
tech.description: Derives motion, force, energy, and momentum from Newton's laws, with lab work throughout.

tech.name: PHYS 110 · Electricity & Magnetism
tech.description: Develops electric and magnetic fields, potentials, circuits, and induction, and ends with Maxwell's equations and the light waves they predict.

tech.name: PHYS 120 · Waves & Optics
tech.description: Covers oscillations, wave propagation, interference, diffraction, and polarization, from sound to lasers.

tech.name: PHYS 130 · Modern Physics
tech.description: Introduces special relativity, the quantum, atomic structure, and nuclear physics, and the experiments that forced each.

tech.name: PHYS 140 · Thermal & Statistical Physics
tech.description: Derives temperature, entropy, and the laws of thermodynamics from the statistics of many particles.

tech.name: PHYS 210 · Quantum Mechanics
tech.description: Develops the Schrödinger equation, operators, angular momentum, and spin, and applies them to atoms and simple systems.

tech.name: PHYS 220 · Solid State Physics
tech.description: Covers crystal structure, phonons, band theory, semiconductors, and superconductivity — the physics inside every device.

tech.name: PHYS 230 · Astrophysics & Cosmology
tech.description: Applies gravity, nuclear physics, and radiation to stars and galaxies, and dates the universe by its microwave background.

tech.name: PHYS 240 · Particle Physics
tech.description: Introduces the Standard Model of quarks, leptons, and forces, and how accelerators and detectors test it.

tech.name: ENVS 101 · Introduction to Environmental Science
tech.description: Surveys the carbon and water cycles, soils, biodiversity, and pollution, with a semester of sampling a local stream.

tech.name: ENVS 110 · Earth Systems & Climate
tech.description: Traces energy and carbon through atmosphere, ocean, and land, and how those systems drive climate and its change.

tech.name: ENVS 120 · Ecosystem Ecology
tech.description: Measures energy flow and nutrient cycling through forests, grasslands, and wetlands, with field and lab methods.

tech.name: ENVS 130 · Environmental Chemistry
tech.description: Follows pollutants through air, water, and soil, with the chemistry of acid rain, ozone, and contaminant fate.

tech.name: ENVS 140 · Geographic Information Systems
tech.description: Builds and analyzes spatial data layers, classifies satellite imagery, and produces a map that answers an environmental question.

tech.name: ENVS 210 · Conservation Biology
tech.description: Applies population genetics and landscape ecology to protecting species and habitats, with the policy and the trade-offs involved.

tech.name: ENVS 220 · Hydrology & Water Resources
tech.description: Covers the water cycle, watersheds, groundwater, and flooding, and how water is allocated among competing users.

tech.name: ENVS 230 · Atmospheric Science
tech.description: Examines weather, air pollution, and climate dynamics, from radiation and cloud physics to numerical forecasting.

tech.name: ENVS 240 · Environmental Policy & Restoration
tech.description: Analyzes the Clean Water Act, the Endangered Species Act, and NEPA, and plans the cleanup and replanting of a degraded site.

tech.name: PSYC 101 · General Psychology
tech.description: Surveys perception, memory, learning, development, personality, and mental illness, and the experiments each finding rests on.

tech.name: PSYC 110 · Developmental Psychology
tech.description: Traces cognitive, social, and emotional development from infancy to old age, and the studies that map each stage.

tech.name: PSYC 120 · Cognitive Psychology
tech.description: Examines attention, memory, language, and reasoning through the experiments that reveal how the mind processes information.

tech.name: PSYC 130 · Abnormal Psychology
tech.description: Classifies mental disorders by the DSM and weighs the evidence on the causes and treatment of anxiety, depression, and psychosis.

tech.name: PSYC 140 · Research Methods in Psychology
tech.description: Designs experiments and surveys, analyzes their data, and confronts the replication problems of the field.

tech.name: PSYC 210 · Social Psychology
tech.description: Studies conformity, persuasion, prejudice, and group behavior through the classic experiments and their modern retests.

tech.name: PSYC 220 · Biopsychology
tech.description: Links behavior to the brain: neurotransmitters, hormones, sleep, and the effects of drugs and damage.

tech.name: PSYC 230 · Organizational Psychology
tech.description: Applies psychology to selection, motivation, leadership, and team performance in the workplace.

tech.name: PSYC 240 · Health Psychology
tech.description: Examines how stress, behavior, and belief affect illness and recovery, and the interventions that change them.

tech.name: PHLT 101 · Introduction to Public Health
tech.description: Compares two neighboring counties' death rates and asks how income, housing and policy explain the gap.

tech.name: PHLT 110 · Epidemiology
tech.description: Measures disease in populations with incidence, prevalence, and risk, and designs the cohort and case-control studies that find its causes.

tech.name: PHLT 120 · Biostatistics
tech.description: Teaches descriptive statistics, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, and simple regression on health data, enough to read a clinical trial's results.

tech.name: PHLT 130 · Health Policy & Management
tech.description: Examines how health systems are financed, regulated, and run, and the policy choices behind coverage, cost, and access.

tech.name: PHLT 140 · Environmental Health
tech.description: Covers air and water pollution, toxic chemicals, and foodborne illness, and the risk assessment and regulation that limit a population's exposure.

tech.name: PHLT 210 · Global Health
tech.description: Examines disease burden, health systems, and interventions in low-income settings, from vaccination campaigns to maternal care.

tech.name: PHLT 220 · Health Promotion
tech.description: Designs programs that change behavior — smoking, diet, screening — using behavioral theory and an evaluation of what worked.

tech.name: PHLT 230 · Community Health Assessment
tech.description: Gathers and analyzes local health data with community partners, and turns it into ranked priorities and an improvement plan.

tech.name: PHLT 240 · Maternal & Child Health
tech.description: Tracks maternal and infant mortality, preterm birth, and childhood immunization, and the prenatal care, WIC, and Medicaid meant to improve them.

tech.name: NURS 101 · Introduction to Professional Nursing
tech.description: Covers a nurse's legal scope of practice and code of ethics, and the hand hygiene, vital signs, and charting that every shift begins with.

tech.name: NURS 110 · Anatomy & Physiology
tech.description: Covers the structure and function of every organ system, with the lab dissection and the physiology a clinician draws on daily.

tech.name: NURS 120 · Pharmacology
tech.description: Teaches drug classes, mechanisms, dosing, and interactions, and the safe administration of medication to patients.

tech.name: NURS 130 · Health Assessment
tech.description: Trains history-taking and head-to-toe physical examination, with the documentation that turns findings into a care plan.

tech.name: NURS 140 · Clinical Practicum I
tech.description: Places students on hospital wards under supervision, giving basic nursing care to real patients for the first time.

tech.name: NURS 210 · Critical Care Nursing
tech.description: Manages ventilated, unstable, and postoperative patients in intensive care, with hemodynamic monitoring, vasoactive drips, and rapid response.

tech.name: NURS 220 · Pediatric Nursing
tech.description: Cares for infants, children, and adolescents, with the growth, dosing, and family communication that differ from adult practice.

tech.name: NURS 230 · Gerontological Nursing
tech.description: Cares for older adults with chronic illness, frailty, dementia, and polypharmacy, at home and in long-term care.

tech.name: NURS 240 · Clinical Practicum II
tech.description: Runs a full patient load on a specialty unit under a preceptor — the transition from student to practicing nurse.

tech.name: NUTR 101 · Fundamentals of Nutrition
tech.description: Reads a food label line by line: the calories and protein first, then the vitamins whose shortfall still causes disease.

tech.name: NUTR 110 · Macronutrients & Metabolism
tech.description: Follows carbohydrates, fats, and proteins from digestion through the metabolic pathways that store and burn them.

tech.name: NUTR 120 · Lifecycle Nutrition
tech.description: Matches nutrient needs to each life stage and its common shortfall: folate in pregnancy, iron in toddlers, protein in old age.

tech.name: NUTR 130 · Applied Dietetics
tech.description: Plans menus and therapeutic diets, such as low-sodium, carbohydrate-controlled, and texture-modified, and documents each case in the nutrition care process.

tech.name: NUTR 140 · Food Science
tech.description: Examines the chemistry, microbiology, and processing of food, from spoilage and preservation to what cooking does to it.

tech.name: NUTR 210 · Sports Nutrition
tech.description: Fuels training and competition with energy, hydration, and timing strategies, and evaluates the supplements athletes take.

tech.name: NUTR 220 · Public Health Nutrition
tech.description: Addresses malnutrition and obesity at the population level, through food policy, school programs, and surveillance.

tech.name: NUTR 230 · Advanced Medical Nutrition Therapy
tech.description: Manages nutrition in diabetes, kidney disease, cancer, and critical illness, including tube and intravenous feeding.

tech.name: NUTR 240 · Nutrition Assessment & Counseling
tech.description: Assesses clients by anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, and dietary data, then counsels them by motivational interviewing in supervised sessions.

tech.name: PHRM 101 · Introduction to Pharmaceutical Sciences
tech.description: Introduces drug discovery, formulation, and the pharmacist's role in patient care.

tech.name: PHRM 110 · Human Physiology for Pharmacy
tech.description: Covers organ-system physiology with the emphasis a pharmacist needs, on the receptors and pathways that drugs act on.

tech.name: PHRM 120 · Pharmaceutical Chemistry
tech.description: Relates drug structure to activity, stability, and formulation, with the organic and analytical chemistry behind each.

tech.name: PHRM 130 · Pharmacology I
tech.description: Covers drug action on the nervous and cardiovascular systems: receptors, dose-response, and the agents used in each.

tech.name: PHRM 140 · Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery
tech.description: Designs dosage forms — tablets, injections, patches — and the kinetics of how a drug is absorbed, distributed, and cleared.

tech.name: PHRM 210 · Pharmacology II
tech.description: Extends drug action to infection, cancer, endocrine, and inflammatory disease, with toxicity and resistance.

tech.name: PHRM 220 · Pharmacotherapeutics
tech.description: Selects and monitors drug therapy for real patient cases, weighing evidence, interactions, and comorbidity.

tech.name: PHRM 230 · Clinical Pharmacy Practicum
tech.description: Places students in a clinic to review medications, counsel patients, and advise prescribers under supervision.

tech.name: PHRM 240 · Pharmacoepidemiology & Drug Safety
tech.description: Studies drug effects after approval through adverse-event reports and claims data, and the boxed warnings and withdrawals they prompt.

tech.name: KINE 101 · Foundations of Kinesiology
tech.description: Surveys human movement — anatomy, physiology, and mechanics — as one connected system.

tech.name: KINE 110 · Functional Anatomy
tech.description: Studies muscles, bones, and joints as a system for movement, with palpation and the analysis of everyday and athletic motion.

tech.name: KINE 120 · Exercise Physiology
tech.description: Measures how the heart, lungs, and muscles respond and adapt to exercise, in the lab with treadmill and metabolic testing.

tech.name: KINE 130 · Biomechanics
tech.description: Applies mechanics to the body — forces, torques, and motion capture — from a golf swing to a fall.

tech.name: KINE 140 · Motor Learning & Control
tech.description: Examines how skills are acquired and coordinated by the nervous system, and how practice and feedback should be structured.

tech.name: KINE 210 · Strength & Conditioning
tech.description: Designs resistance and conditioning programs for athletes, with periodization, performance testing, and the coaching of lifting technique.

tech.name: KINE 220 · Athletic Injury & Rehabilitation
tech.description: Assesses and rehabilitates common sports injuries, from acute care and taping to return-to-play progressions.

tech.name: KINE 230 · Exercise Testing & Prescription
tech.description: Screens clients for risk, runs graded exercise tests, and writes a program's frequency, intensity, time, and type to ACSM guidelines.

tech.name: KINE 240 · Adapted Physical Activity
tech.description: Designs physical activity for people with disabilities and chronic conditions, with inclusion and safety as the starting points.

tech.name: Neuroscience Labs
tech.description: Specialized lab space — required for the Neuroscience program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: NEUR 101 · Foundations of Neuroscience
tech.description: Follows a reflex, a memory and a decision from the neurons that carry them to the behavior they produce.

tech.name: NEUR 110 · Neuroanatomy
tech.description: Maps the structures of the brain and spinal cord, their connections, and what damage to each does, with brain dissection in the lab.

tech.name: NEUR 120 · Cellular & Molecular Neuroscience
tech.description: Covers ion channels, action potentials, synaptic transmission, and the molecular machinery of the neuron.

tech.name: NEUR 130 · Cognitive Neuroscience
tech.description: Links perception, memory, language, and decision-making to brain systems, through imaging, lesion, and recording studies.

tech.name: NEUR 140 · Neurophysiology
tech.description: Records and analyzes electrical activity at three scales: the patch-clamped single cell, the circuit, and the scalp EEG.

tech.name: NEUR 210 · Neuropharmacology
tech.description: Examines how drugs act on neurotransmitter systems, in the treatment of disorders and in addiction.

tech.name: NEUR 220 · Developmental Neurobiology
tech.description: Traces how the nervous system is built, from neural induction and axon guidance to synapse formation and plasticity.

tech.name: NEUR 230 · Computational Neuroscience
tech.description: Models neurons and networks mathematically, from the Hodgkin-Huxley equations to learning rules and neural coding.

tech.name: NEUR 240 · Clinical Neuroscience & Disorders
tech.description: Examines stroke, epilepsy, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, and psychiatric illness at the level of mechanism and treatment.

tech.name: Computing Research Center
tech.description: A compute cluster and research offices — required for the Computer Science program's capstone courses, and lets the college produce research.

tech.name: COMP 101 · Introduction to Programming
tech.description: Writes small programs that read, loop and decide, and learns to find its own bugs before a grader does.

tech.name: COMP 110 · Data Structures
tech.description: Implements lists, stacks, trees, hash tables, and graphs, and analyzes which one a problem needs and at what cost.

tech.name: COMP 120 · Algorithms
tech.description: Designs and analyzes algorithms — sorting, graph search, dynamic programming, greedy methods — with proofs of correctness and running time.

tech.name: COMP 130 · Operating Systems
tech.description: Explains what an operating system does for a program — processes, scheduling, virtual memory, files — and writes concurrent code that uses it.

tech.name: COMP 140 · Computer Architecture
tech.description: Covers instruction sets, pipelining, caches, and the memory hierarchy, and how hardware decides what software runs fast.

tech.name: COMP 210 · Compiler Design
tech.description: Writes a compiler from lexing and parsing through type checking, optimization, and code generation for a real target.

tech.name: COMP 220 · Game Development
tech.description: Builds a playable game as a team, with a rendering loop, physics, input, and the design iteration that makes it fun.

tech.name: COMP 230 · Parallel Computing
tech.description: Programs multicore, GPU, and distributed systems with threads and message passing, and measures the speedup actually obtained.

tech.name: COMP 240 · Web Development
tech.description: Ships a full-stack web application to outside users, with authentication, caching, load testing, and the attacks a public site has to withstand.

tech.name: DATA 101 · Fundamentals of Data Science
tech.description: Takes a messy public dataset from download to a first chart, cleaning and questioning it at every step.

tech.name: DATA 110 · Statistical Modeling
tech.description: Fits linear and generalized linear models, checks their assumptions, and reads what the coefficients do and do not claim.

tech.name: DATA 120 · Machine Learning
tech.description: Trains and evaluates supervised and unsupervised models — regression, trees, clustering, neural networks — with the bias-variance trade-off throughout.

tech.name: DATA 130 · Data Visualization
tech.description: Designs charts and interactive graphics that make a dataset's structure legible, and learns what makes a visualization mislead.

tech.name: DATA 140 · Data Mining
tech.description: Finds patterns in large datasets with association rules, clustering, and anomaly detection, and validates that they are real.

tech.name: DATA 210 · Big Data Systems
tech.description: Splits storage and computation across a cluster, and decides when a batch job, a stream, or one large server is the cheaper way to an answer.

tech.name: DATA 220 · Time Series Analysis
tech.description: Models trend, seasonality, and autocorrelation with ARIMA and state-space methods, and forecasts with honest uncertainty.

tech.name: DATA 230 · Natural Language Processing
tech.description: Builds systems that parse, classify, and generate text, from n-grams to transformer language models.

tech.name: DATA 240 · Bayesian Statistics
tech.description: Starts from a prior belief, updates it with data by the rules of probability, and lets small groups such as counties borrow strength from one another.

tech.name: CYBR 101 · Introduction to Cybersecurity
tech.description: Surveys who attacks computer systems and why, and the plain controls — patching, backups, least privilege — that stop most attacks.

tech.name: CYBR 110 · Network Security
tech.description: Secures networks with firewalls, intrusion detection, VPNs, and protocol hardening, against attacks run in a lab.

tech.name: CYBR 120 · Cryptography
tech.description: Covers symmetric and public-key ciphers, hashes, signatures, and protocols, and how sound mathematics still fails in careless code.

tech.name: CYBR 130 · Ethical Hacking
tech.description: Runs authorized penetration tests — reconnaissance, exploitation, privilege escalation — and writes the report that makes the findings fixable.

tech.name: CYBR 140 · Security Operations
tech.description: Runs a security operations center: log analysis, monitoring, incident response, and the playbooks for when something gets through.

tech.name: CYBR 210 · Cloud Security
tech.description: Secures identity, storage, networking, and workloads on public cloud platforms, where a misconfiguration is the usual cause of a breach.

tech.name: CYBR 220 · Digital Forensics
tech.description: Acquires and analyzes evidence from disks, memory, and networks in a way that holds up in court.

tech.name: CYBR 230 · Security Risk Management
tech.description: Assesses threats, vulnerabilities, and impact to prioritize controls, and maps them to the compliance frameworks an organization is audited against.

tech.name: CYBR 240 · Software Security Testing
tech.description: Finds vulnerabilities in code with static analysis, fuzzing, and code review, and builds the practices that keep them out.

tech.name: SOFT 101 · Introduction to Software Development
tech.description: Writes small programs in a team, with version control, code review, and tests, and ships one against a written requirement.

tech.name: SOFT 110 · Software Requirements
tech.description: Elicits, specifies, and validates what a system must do, with stakeholders who disagree and needs that change.

tech.name: SOFT 120 · Software Testing & QA
tech.description: Designs unit, integration, and system tests, automates them, and measures coverage and defect rates as a quality process.

tech.name: SOFT 130 · Database Systems
tech.description: Designs relational schemas, writes SQL, and covers transactions, indexing, and the guarantees a database makes or does not.

tech.name: SOFT 140 · Object-Oriented Design
tech.description: Applies design patterns, SOLID principles, and refactoring to build systems that survive being changed.

tech.name: SOFT 210 · Agile Methodologies
tech.description: Runs a project in sprints with a product backlog, stand-ups, and retrospectives, and examines what agile fixes and what it hides.

tech.name: SOFT 220 · Mobile Application Development
tech.description: Builds native apps for phones, with touch interfaces, offline data, sensors, and the constraints of battery and screen.

tech.name: SOFT 230 · UI/UX
tech.description: Designs interfaces from user research and prototypes through usability testing, with accessibility as a requirement rather than an afterthought.

tech.name: SOFT 240 · DevOps
tech.description: Automates build, test, and deployment pipelines with containers, infrastructure as code, and monitoring, so that releases become routine.

tech.name: ARTF 101 · Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
tech.description: Surveys search, logic, probabilistic reasoning, and learning from data, and the two funding winters that followed when the field overpromised.

tech.name: ARTF 110 · AI Programming
tech.description: Implements search, constraint satisfaction, and probabilistic reasoning in code — the classical toolkit under modern systems.

tech.name: ARTF 120 · Knowledge Representation
tech.description: Encodes facts and rules in logics and ontologies, reasons over them with inference engines, and finds where those give out.

tech.name: ARTF 130 · Neural Networks
tech.description: Builds and trains multilayer networks from backpropagation up, with the optimization and regularization that make them learn.

tech.name: ARTF 140 · Statistical Learning
tech.description: Fits and compares the workhorse methods of machine learning — decision trees, random forests, boosting — and judges each on data it has not seen.

tech.name: ARTF 210 · Deep Learning
tech.description: Trains convolutional, recurrent, and transformer networks at scale, where the hard part is feeding the GPUs and keeping a week-long run alive.

tech.name: ARTF 220 · Robotics & Perception
tech.description: Gives a robot senses and plans — localization, mapping, motion planning, and control — on real hardware.

tech.name: ARTF 230 · Computer Vision
tech.description: Finds, outlines, and names objects in images and video, first with hand-built features and then with the deep networks that replaced them.

tech.name: ARTF 240 · AI Ethics & Society
tech.description: Examines bias, accountability, surveillance, and labor displacement in deployed AI, and the governance proposed for it.

tech.name: INFO 101 · Introduction to Information Systems
tech.description: Walks one order through the systems a firm runs on — web store, database, warehouse software, general ledger — and asks who owns each.

tech.name: INFO 110 · Systems Analysis & Design
tech.description: Models an organization's processes and data, and specifies the information system that would serve them, with the stakeholders in the room.

tech.name: INFO 120 · Database Management
tech.description: Administers databases in production — schema changes, query tuning, backup, security — and weighs when a non-relational store earns its place.

tech.name: INFO 130 · Enterprise Resource Planning
tech.description: Configures an enterprise system across finance, supply chain, and HR, and studies why so many implementations overrun.

tech.name: INFO 140 · IT Infrastructure
tech.description: Covers servers, networks, virtualization, and cloud services, and how an organization provisions, secures, and pays for them.

tech.name: INFO 210 · Business Process Modeling
tech.description: Maps and redesigns workflows with process notation and simulation, and counts the handoffs and waiting time a redesign removes.

tech.name: INFO 220 · E-commerce Strategy
tech.description: Analyzes online business models, platforms, payments, and logistics, and what makes a digital marketplace defensible.

tech.name: INFO 230 · Information Security Management
tech.description: Builds an organization's security program: policy, risk assessment, awareness, and governance under regulation.

tech.name: INFO 240 · Data Warehousing
tech.description: Designs dimensional models and ETL pipelines that feed analytics and reporting, and keeps the numbers consistent across them.
